people.name: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.title: The Last Messenger of Allah & Seal of the Prophets
people.birth: 570 CE (12 Rabi' al-Awwal / Year of the Elephant), Mecca
people.biography: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born in Mecca in 570 CE into the noble Hashim clan of the Quraysh tribe. Known from his youth as Al-Amin (The Trustworthy) and As-Sadiq (The Truthful), he received the first revelation of the Holy Qur'an from Allah through the Angel Jibril (Gabriel) at age 40 in the Cave of Hira. He preached the oneness of God (Tawhid), moral integrity, social justice, and compassion. After facing years of persecution in Mecca, he migrated to Medina (The Hijrah) in 622 CE, establishing the first Islamic community. By the time of his passing in 632 CE, Islam had spread throughout the Arabian Peninsula, establishing a universal legacy of faith, brotherhood, and human dignity.

timeline.event: Born in Mecca during the Year of the Elephant.
Receives the first revelation in the Cave of Hira.
Victory at the Battle of Badr.
Conquest of Mecca with peaceful entry and universal amnesty.
Delivers Farewell Sermon at Mount Arafat and passes away in Medina.

people.notes: Central focal figure of the family tree and the Islamic faith.

people.name: Abdullah ibn Abdul-Muttalib
people.title: Father of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Abdullah ibn Abdul-Muttalib was the youngest and favorite son of Abdul-Muttalib. He married Aminah bint Wahb of the Banu Zuhrah clan. Abdullah passed away on a trading voyage return journey in Yathrib (Medina) a few months before Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born.

timeline.event: Passes away in Yathrib shortly before the Prophet's birth.

people.name: Aminah bint Wahb
people.title: Mother of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Aminah bint Wahb was a noble woman from Banu Zuhrah, renowned for her virtue and intelligence. She gave birth to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in Mecca. She passed away at Al-Abwa when Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was six years old while returning from visiting relatives in Medina.

timeline.event: Born in Mecca to Wahb ibn Abd Manaf.
Gives birth to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

references.title: History of the Prophets and Kings

people.name: Abdul-Muttalib ibn Hashim
people.title: Grandfather & Guardian of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Abdul-Muttalib was the leader of the Quraysh tribe and custodian of the Kaaba. He rediscovered the ancient Well of Zamzam. Following the passing of Aminah, he took guardianship of his grandson Muhammad ﷺ and loved him dearly until his own passing.

timeline.event: Rediscovers the Well of Zamzam in Mecca.
Protects Mecca against Abrahah during the Elephant Incident.

people.name: Fatimah bint Amr
people.title: Paternal Grandmother of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Fatimah bint Amr was from the Banu Makhzum clan of Quraysh. She was the primary wife of Abdul-Muttalib and mother of Abdullah, Abu Talib, and Zubayr.
people.notes: Grandmother of both Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and Ali ibn Abi Talib.

people.name: Wahb ibn Abd Manaf
people.title: Maternal Grandfather of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Wahb was the chief of Banu Zuhrah clan of Quraysh, known for his high stature and honor in Mecca.

people.name: Abu Talib ibn Abdul-Muttalib
people.title: Uncle & Guardian of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Abu Talib raised Prophet Muhammad ﷺ after Abdul-Muttalib's death. He stood firmly as his chief protector in Mecca against the hostile Quraysh leaders for over a decade. His death in 619 CE was marked as the Year of Sorrow (Aam al-Huzn).

timeline.event: Assumes guardianship of young Muhammad ﷺ.
Endures the 3-year Quraysh boycott in Shi'b Abi Talib.
Passes away in Mecca during Year of Sorrow.

people.notes: Father of Ali ibn Abi Talib.

people.name: Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib (RA)
people.title: Sayyid ash-Shuhada (Master of Martyrs)
people.biography: Hamza (RA) was the uncle and foster brother of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Known as Asadullah (The Lion of Allah), he accepted Islam in Mecca, greatly strengthening the early Muslims. He displayed unmatched bravery at the Battle of Badr and was martyred at Uhud.

timeline.event: Martyred at the Battle of Uhud.

people.name: Al-Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib (RA)
people.title: Paternal Uncle of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Al-Abbas (RA) was a wealthy merchant who protected Prophet Muhammad ﷺ during the Second Pledge of Aqabah. He accepted Islam, migrated to Medina, and supported the Prophet in his campaigns. Ancestor of the Abbasid Dynasty.

timeline.event: Participates in the Conquest of Mecca and Hunayn.
Passes away during Caliphate of Uthman (RA).

people.notes: Father of the great Quranic commentator Abdullah ibn Abbas.

people.name: Abu Lahab (Abdul Uzza)
people.title: Paternal Uncle who opposed Islam
people.biography: Abu Lahab was an uncle of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ who fiercely opposed his message and harassed Muslims. Mentioned specifically in Surah Al-Masad.

people.name: Safiyyah bint Abdul-Muttalib (RA)
people.title: Paternal Aunt of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Safiyyah (RA) was a courageous aunt of the Prophet ﷺ who embraced Islam early in Mecca, migrated to Medina, and actively defended the Muslim encampment during the Battle of the Trench.

people.name: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (First Wife & First Believer)
people.death: 619 CE (3 BH / Year of Sorrow), Mecca
people.biography: Khadijah (RA) was a successful, noble businesswoman of Mecca known as Amirat Quraysh (Princess of Quraysh) and At-Tahirah (The Pure). She married Prophet Muhammad ﷺ when he was 25 and she was 40. She was the first person to embrace Islam, comforting him upon his first revelation and devoting her wealth and life to supporting the divine message. She was his sole wife for 25 years until her passing.

timeline.event: Becomes the first believer in Islam.
Passes away during Year of Sorrow.

references.title: Khadija: Mother of History's Greatest Nation

people.notes: Mother of six children of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

people.name: Sawda bint Zam'a (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (Mother of the Believers)
people.biography: Sawda (RA) was an early Muslim who migrated to Abyssinia. After the passing of Khadijah (RA), she became the Prophet's wife in Mecca, known for her generosity, piety, and warm humor.

timeline.event: Marries Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in Mecca.

people.name: Aisha bint Abi Bakr (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (Scholar & Narrator of Hadith)
people.biography: Aisha (RA), daughter of Caliph Abu Bakr (RA), was one of the greatest scholars in Islamic history. She narrated over 2,200 Hadiths and taught Islamic law, medicine, poetry, and theology to numerous companions and followers.

timeline.event: Marries Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in Medina.
Prophet Muhammad ﷺ passes away in her home.
Passes away in Medina at age 64.

references.title: Aisha: The Wife, The Companion, The Scholar

people.name: Hafsa bint Umar (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (Custodian of the Quranic Manuscript)
people.biography: Hafsa (RA), daughter of Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA), married the Prophet ﷺ in Medina after her first husband was martyred at Badr. She was literate, devout, and entrusted with keeping the master copy of the Holy Qur'an compiled under Abu Bakr (RA).
people.notes: Preserved the first consolidated text of the Qur'an.

people.name: Zainab bint Khuzaymah (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (Umm al-Masakin - Mother of the Poor)
people.biography: Zainab bint Khuzaymah (RA) was celebrated for her immense charity and care for the needy, earning her the title 'Mother of the Poor' before Islam. She passed away just a few months after marrying the Prophet ﷺ.

people.name: Um Salama / Hind bint Abi Umayya (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (Wise Advisor & Scholar)
people.biography: Um Salama (RA) was an early Muslim convert who migrated to Abyssinia and Medina. Known for her wisdom, political insight, and religious knowledge, she gave pivotal advice during the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah.

timeline.event: Marries Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in Medina.
Provides crucial counsel during Treaty of Hudaybiyyah.
Passes away in Medina as the last surviving wife of the Prophet.

people.name: Zainab bint Jahsh (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (Devout Crafts-woman & Philanthropist)
people.biography: Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) was the cousin of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. She was skilled in leathercraft, earning income which she gave entirely to charity. Her marriage to the Prophet was explicitly ordained in Surah Al-Ahzab to repeal pre-Islamic adoption taboos.

timeline.event: Marries Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in Medina.
Passes away in Medina during Omar's Caliphate.

people.name: Juwayriya bint al-Harith (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (Bringer of Blessing to Banu Mustaliq)
people.biography: Juwayriya (RA) was the daughter of the chief of Banu al-Mustaliq. Upon her marriage to the Prophet ﷺ, all captives of her tribe were freed by the Muslims out of respect for her family.

people.name: Ramla bint Abi Sufyan / Um Habiba (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (Steadfast Believer)
people.biography: Ramla (RA), also known as Um Habiba, endured harsh trial when she migrated to Abyssinia. Prophet Muhammad ﷺ sent Negus (King of Abyssinia) to propose on his behalf while she was in Abyssinia.

timeline.event: Marries Prophet Muhammad ﷺ via proxy in Abyssinia.

people.name: Safiyya bint Huyayy (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (Descendant of Prophet Harun/Aaron)
people.biography: Safiyya (RA) was a noble woman from Banu Nadir and a direct descendant of Prophet Harun (Aaron). Prophet Muhammad ﷺ treated her with immense honor and affection.

timeline.event: Marries Prophet Muhammad ﷺ after Khaybar.

people.name: Maymunah bint al-Harith (RA)
people.title: Ummat-ul-Mu'minin (The Last Married Wife)
people.biography: Maymunah (RA) was the last wife Prophet Muhammad ﷺ married, during the Umrah al-Qada (Compensatory Pilgrimage) in 629 CE at Saraf.

timeline.event: Marries Prophet Muhammad ﷺ at Saraf.
Passes away at the exact location of her marriage in Saraf.

people.notes: Aunt of Ibn Abbas and Khalid ibn al-Walid.

people.name: Mariya al-Qibtiyya (RA)
people.title: Mother of Ibrahim ibn Muhammad
people.biography: Mariya al-Qibtiyya was a devout Coptic Christian noblewoman sent as a gift from Al-Muqawqis (Ruler of Alexandria) to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. She accepted Islam and gave birth to the Prophet's youngest son, Ibrahim.

timeline.event: Passes away in Medina during Omar's Caliphate.

people.name: Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad
people.title: Eldest Son of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Al-Qasim was the eldest child of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and Khadijah (RA). From him, the Prophet took his Kunya 'Abu al-Qasim' (Father of Qasim). He passed away in early childhood in Mecca.

people.name: Abdullah ibn Muhammad
people.title: Son of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ (At-Tayyib & At-Tahir)
people.biography: Abdullah was born after Prophet Muhammad ﷺ received prophecy. He passed away in early childhood in Mecca.

people.name: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad
people.title: Youngest Son of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Ibrahim was born in Medina to Mariya al-Qibtiyya. Prophet Muhammad ﷺ expressed profound tenderness for him. Upon his passing at 16 months, a solar eclipse occurred; the Prophet ﷺ clarified that celestial events do not occur for the birth or death of any human.

timeline.event: Passes away in Medina; solar eclipse sermon delivered.

references.title: Sahih al-Bukhari
references.source: Hadith on the Death of Ibrahim

people.name: Zainab bint Muhammad (RA)
people.title: Eldest Daughter of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Zainab (RA) was the eldest daughter of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. She married her maternal cousin Abu al-As ibn al-Rabi. She accepted Islam in Mecca and later migrated to Medina.

people.name: Ruqayyah bint Muhammad (RA)
people.title: Daughter of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ & Wife of Uthman (RA)
people.biography: Ruqayyah (RA) married Uthman ibn Affan (RA) and migrated with him first to Abyssinia and then to Medina. She passed away during the Battle of Badr.

timeline.event: Passes away in Medina as news of Badr victory arrives.

aliases: Dhat al-Hijratayn (Migrant of Two Migration Places)
people.notes: First wife of Uthman ibn Affan (RA).

people.name: Umm Kulthum bint Muhammad (RA)
people.title: Daughter of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ & Wife of Uthman (RA)
people.biography: Umm Kulthum (RA) migrated to Medina with her sister Fatimah (RA). Following the passing of Ruqayyah, she married Uthman ibn Affan (RA), earning Uthman the title 'Dhu al-Nurayn' (Possessor of Two Lights).
people.notes: Second daughter of Prophet married to Uthman (RA).

people.name: Fatimah al-Zahra (RA)
people.title: Sayyidat Nisa' al-Alamin (Leader of Women of Paradise)
people.biography: Fatimah al-Zahra (RA) was the beloved youngest daughter of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. She was deeply devoted to her father, known as Ummi Abiha (Mother of her Father). She married Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA) and was the mother of Hasan and Husayn (RA). The Prophet ﷺ declared her to be the leader of all women in Paradise.

timeline.event: Marries Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA) in Medina.
Passes away in Medina 6 months after Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

people.notes: Direct lineage of the Prophet continues through Fatimah (RA).

people.name: Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA)
people.title: Fourth Rightly Guided Caliph & Cousin/Son-in-law
people.biography: Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA) was the first child to accept Islam. He was raised in the household of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Known for his legendary courage, eloquence, wisdom, and deep knowledge of Quranic jurisprudence. Married Fatimah (RA) and served as the Fourth Caliph of Islam.

timeline.event: Born inside the Kaaba in Mecca.
First male youth to embrace Islam.
Sleeps in the Prophet's bed during Hijrah to protect him.

people.name: Uthman ibn Affan (RA)
people.title: Third Rightly Guided Caliph (Dhu al-Nurayn)
people.biography: Uthman ibn Affan (RA) was known for his modesty, generosity, and piety. Married Ruqayyah (RA) and later Umm Kulthum (RA). As Third Caliph, he standardized the official written text of the Holy Qur'an.

timeline.event: Standardizes the official compilation of the Qur'an.

people.name: Abu al-As ibn al-Rabi (RA)
people.title: Son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Abu al-As was a prominent merchant of Mecca married to Zainab (RA). He accepted Islam and was praised by Prophet Muhammad ﷺ for his trustworthiness and devotion.

people.name: Al-Hasan ibn Ali (RA)
people.title: Sayyid Shabab Ahl al-Jannah & Fifth Caliph
people.biography: Al-Hasan (RA) was the elder grandson of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Prophet Muhammad ﷺ loved him dearly and foretold that Allah would reconcile two large Muslim groups through him. In 661 CE, Hasan voluntarily abdicated the Caliphate to secure peace and prevent bloodshed among Muslims.

timeline.event: Becomes Caliph and signs Peace Treaty with Muawiyah to unify Muslims.

people.name: Al-Husayn ibn Ali (RA)
people.title: Sayyid ash-Shuhada & Grandson of the Prophet
people.biography: Al-Husayn (RA) was the younger grandson of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Renowned for his unwavering principle, moral bravery, and devotion to Islamic justice. He stood against tyranny at Karbala, where he was martyred on Ashura along with his loyal companions.

timeline.event: Martyred at the Battle of Karbala on 10 Muharram.

people.name: Muhsin ibn Ali
people.title: Son of Fatimah (RA) & Ali (RA)
people.biography: Muhsin was the youngest child of Fatimah al-Zahra (RA) and Ali (RA), who passed away in infancy.

people.name: Zainab bint Ali (RA)
people.title: Heroine of Karbala & Granddaughter of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Zainab bint Ali (RA) was famous for her eloquence, courage, and leadership following the tragedy of Karbala. Her courageous speeches preserved the truthful record of Karbala.

timeline.event: Delivers powerful speeches in Kufa and Damascus.

people.name: Umm Kulthum bint Ali (RA)
people.title: Granddaughter of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Umm Kulthum bint Ali (RA) was the younger daughter of Fatimah (RA) and Ali (RA). She married Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA).

people.name: Ali ibn Abi al-As
people.title: Grandson of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Ali was the grandson of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ through his eldest daughter Zainab (RA). He passed away during adolescence.

people.name: Umamah bint Abi al-As (RA)
people.title: Beloved Granddaughter of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Umamah (RA) was beloved by Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, who used to carry her during prayer when she was a young child. After Fatimah's passing, Ali (RA) married her as advised by Fatimah (RA).

references.title: Sahih al-Bukhari
references.source: Hadith on Prophet carrying Umamah in prayer

people.name: Abdullah ibn Uthman
people.title: Grandson of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
people.biography: Abdullah was born in Abyssinia to Ruqayyah (RA) and Uthman (RA). He passed away at age 6 in Medina.
